notes: litert-community/Qwen3-32B: qwen3_32b_int8_ekv4096.litertlm, a LiteRT-LM conversion of Qwen/Qwen3-32B at revision 9216db57 (Apache-2.0), a dense 64-layer decoder with thinking on by default, text in, text out; exported with litert-torch 0.10.0's export_hf and its GPU composites (one prefill and one decode signature), every linear layer, both lm_heads and the token table int8 per channel (ai-edge-quantizer 0.10.1), fp32 activations declared; LiteRT-LM 0.19.1's own Qwen3 metadata byte for byte and the checkpoint's tokenizer.json byte for byte. Published for the GPU backend only: on the CPU, LiteRT-LM 0.19.1 quantizes each int8 layer's input to int8 at run time, and the bundle's TFLite section on that path (ai-edge-litert, XNNPACK) matched the bf16 checkpoint's top-1 token at 18 of 24 positions of the test prompt (the card says so; not a record here). Mac Studio rows only: the file is 32.9 GB and no phone was tried. Window w2 of the same day re-ran the GPU cell on these bytes (150.53 / 12.04 tok/s) and ran them at max_num_tokens 4,096 (151.81 / 11.91 tok/s); both, not entered (one gpu@1024tok slot per file and date; w1 is the card's). Landed 2026-11-09: litert-community/Qwen3-32B is public and ungated (license apache-2.0, base_model Qwen/Qwen3-32B quantized, library_name litert-lm), upload commit d8c78c1d8d (2026-11-09T03:58:42.000Z), main d8aa56b39d (the card commit, 2026-11-09T07:58:17.000Z) at the read; the tree's LFS oid and size of qwen3_32b_int8_ekv4096.litertlm = artifact_sha256 and 32892029424 B (anonymous, read 2026-11-09 17:23:41 JST).
quantization: int8 per-channel min-max weights (ai-edge-quantizer 0.10.1) for every FULLY_CONNECTED, both lm_heads included, and the token table; fp32 activations declared (prefer_activation_type fp32); the prefill length and the KV length are magic numbers that LiteRT-LM sets at load time (1,024 and 4,096 by default); KV cache magic number (4,096 by default; 2,048 in the benchmark rows)
